scope: Additive native-independent renderer diagnostic questions, authored with this bounded implementation; a development set, not held-out evaluation. Existing general and mission questions remain unchanged.

questions.query: Can isolated PUBPRES renderer diagnostics run before native builds, what finite Linux and Windows controls run, and do they qualify gameplay or a package?
facts: Only the pinned engine, Python process owner and Linux owned display are needed; no GDExtension or native build is loaded.
Linux has four font controls and Windows has two empty startup controls; both have Safe reachable R8 slots2/3 and Separate slots2/1, with 60 seconds per actual Godot child plus bounded cleanup.
Native-independent diagnostic results do not establish gameplay, pacing, performance, package or physical Windows/NVIDIA acceptance; Draft/HOLD and Separate qualification remain separate.

questions.query: Can later correct queued material pixels erase a failed first read, and what happens when a Separate diagnostic crashes or times out?
facts: The frozen a707 publisher/shader/base fixture and original first current/previous byte assertions are preserved; all added reads happen after the publication burst and original oracle.
Later exact pixels cannot erase the first-read failure, and selected diagnostics cannot replace the original complete fixture.
Ordinary failed arms retain raw process/receipt evidence and the matrix continues before aggregate nonzero; cancellation or uncertain ownership is terminal and remaining arms are recorded not run.
Source, engine, script, PID, nonce and empty loaded extensions are joined; a startup failure never receives an invented completed script receipt.
